phase: Confirmation of the selected public procedure on fresh seeds. Frozen before generation; results do not change the procedure.

procedure.call: wade.wade(counts, cond, direction='both', scale='linear', normalization=RLE fit on the complete matrix, test_genes=wade.filter_counts(counts, min_count=3, min_samples=2), seed=permutation_seed)

comparator: One-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum per direction (asymptotic, tie-corrected) on the same normalized counts and test mask; one BH family over both directions, as for WADE
null: Independent biological patients; exposures independent of condition; no injected group confounding

generator.retired: bulk_half_subset_up_10pct_4x: below the information limit (2026-09-27 review); replaced by the 8-1024x raised-subset series

endpoints.calibration: Per matrix: false gene-direction calls on unaltered genes (background and shared-tail nulls) over all gene-direction calls; complete-null any-call rate
endpoints.power: Share of each profile x abundance called in its intended direction, and in the other direction, over all replicates
endpoints.direction_errors: Up calls on bulk_down_two_thirds and down calls on bulk_up_1.5x
